prepared_by.method: single read-only streaming pass over the official input; independent of the enhancement helper

row_policy.row_unit: one source transaction line; InvoiceNo is not unique per row
row_policy.currency: GBP, as stated for UnitPrice in the Online Retail dataset convention; no FX conversion
row_policy.eligible_sales: InvoiceNo is not blank after trimming ASCII spaces and is not prefixed C; Quantity and UnitPrice are native numeric cells greater than zero; InvoiceDate is a numeric Excel date serial in the valid range 1..2958465 (date-like text is excluded)
row_policy.cancellations: InvoiceNo beginning C (case-insensitive) excluded from positive-sales metrics
row_policy.returns: Quantity <= 0 excluded from positive-sales metrics; original rows remain unchanged
row_policy.price: UnitPrice <= 0 excluded; original values remain unchanged
row_policy.missing_fields: Blank InvoiceNo after ASCII-space trimming, nonnumeric/missing Quantity or UnitPrice, and nonnumeric/out-of-range/missing InvoiceDate are excluded from positive-sale metrics; missing CustomerID is retained and counted diagnostically
row_policy.invoice_metric: distinct InvoiceNo identifiers among eligible lines, not a count of unique orders or customers
row_policy.monthly_chart: eligible gross line sales for native dates from 2010-01-01 inclusive to 2011-01-01 exclusive; full-period KPIs use all eligible dates

time_scope.full_period_kpis: All eligible InvoiceDate values across the complete source table.
time_scope.monthly_chart: Native dates from 2010-01-01 inclusive to 2011-01-01 exclusive only; a different time range than the full-period KPIs.

diagnostics.distinct_invoice_note: InvoiceNo is repeated across lines; not treated as a row count.
diagnostics.counting_method: one streaming read_only pass; one transaction line per row; no source rows are removed
